slides.sub: 823 acres, a 16.5-mile trail and a mill from 1750. Swipe for all 3.
slides.source: Morris County Park Commission; Washington Township Land Trust (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: Schooley's Mountain County Park
slides.body: A county park with trails, a lodge and boathouse on George Lake, and a lookout up the mountain.
slides.source: Morris County Park Commission, morrisparks.net; Washington Twp. Recreation (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: Columbia Trail
slides.body: A stone dust trail for hiking and biking. Leashed pets are welcome. It runs from western Morris County into Hunterdon County.

slides.title: Obadiah LaTourette Mill
slides.body: A 1750 grist and saw mill in the center of Long Valley. The Washington Township Land Trust is restoring it.
slides.source: Washington Township Land Trust, wtlt.org; LVVA (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: 3 stops, one town
slides.tip: NJ has 4 Washington Townships. Long Valley's is in Morris County, so add the county to your search.
slides.source: Morris County Park Commission; Washington Township Land Trust (Nov. 2026)
